title: contextlib：生成器式上下文与 ExitStack
expected_output:
嵌套 with（先开后关，逆序释放）:
> A
> B
> C
body
< C
< B
< A

ExitStack（动态数量资源同样逆序释放）:
> r1
> r2
> r3
body
< r3
< r2
< r1

要点: 无 @contextmanager 时 finally 里 yield 会吞掉上游异常; 加了就正确传播
code:
from contextlib import contextmanager, ExitStack


@contextmanager
def step(name, box):
    box.append("> " + name)
    try:
        yield name
    finally:
        box.append("< " + name)


box1 = []
with step("A", box1):
    with step("B", box1):
        with step("C", box1):
            box1.append("body")
print("嵌套 with（先开后关，逆序释放）:")
print("\n".join(box1))
print()

box2 = []
with ExitStack() as stack:
    for n in ("r1", "r2", "r3"):
        stack.enter_context(step(n, box2))
    box2.append("body")
print("ExitStack（动态数量资源同样逆序释放）:")
print("\n".join(box2))
print()
print("要点: 无 @contextmanager 时 finally 里 yield 会吞掉上游异常; 加了就正确传播")
